create_view_config: create a ViewConfig to define a dataset view with input dataset and example transformations
build_view_builder: build a ViewBuilder subclass that transforms an existing dataset with per-example or tf.data transformations
run_example_transformations: run per-example transformations on a TFDS dataset using ViewBuilder with example transform functions
run_dataset_transformations: run tf.data.Dataset transformations on a TFDS dataset using ViewBuilder with dataset transform functions
run_beam_transformations: run per-example transformations on a TFDS dataset using Apache Beam with ViewBuilder and USE_BEAM enabled
